extracted.name: My Special Shrimp Scampi Florentine
extracted.description: My special shrimp scampi Florentine recipe has the fresh flavors of tomatoes, fresh spinach, and pesto. Serve it over rice with hot Italian bread.
ingredient_lines: 2 large plum tomatoes, seeded and diced
2 tablespoons prepared basil pesto (such as Classico ™)
0.25 teaspoon red pepper flakes, or to taste
1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 cups fresh spinach, rinsed and stemmed
instruction_lines: Combine butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in tomatoes, pesto, and garlic; simmer until tomatoes start to soften, about 2 minutes. Season with pepper flakes and black pepper.
Stir shrimp into sauce; cook just until they turn pink, 3 to 5 minutes. Add spinach; stir until wilted, about 1 minute.
